subdivision.title: Subdivision surfaces
subdivision.about: Model a rough cage of quads and smooth it, the way Blender’s Subdivision modifier does (subd / subdivide).

photo-modeling.title: Model from photos
photo-modeling.about: Mark the same corners in two matched photos; SketchCraft works out where they are in 3D and builds the faces.

hierarchy-tags.title: Groups, hierarchy and tags
hierarchy-tags.about: Groups inside groups, a click that picks the whole house, hiding a whole chain, and tags with colors and solo.

environments.title: Environments
environments.about: Put a model in a ready-made setting (suburban lot, city block, park, desert, waterfront) in one click.

studio-render.title: Studio renders
studio-render.about: A seamless studio backdrop with softbox lights, and a photoreal render that sharpens while you watch.

workspaces-skins.title: Workspaces and skins
workspaces-skins.about: Arch, Design and Previz arrange the tools for the job; skins change the whole look, and you can make your own.
